 MISSOULA, Mont. — Missoula County property tax bills are in the mail. The county says bills are also available online at missoulataxes.us.
 If you don’t pay your property taxes through your mortgage, the deadline for the first half of your 2026 taxes is Nov. 30, with the second half due June 1, 2027.
 The county says those deadlines apply to payments that are postmarked by the due dates.
 Property owners can check the county’s website for their bills and more information on paying.
